title: ALLOW_BULK_COMMIT is read from the environment by pre-commit, from the message only by the push-range check
body: The bulk declaration has two channels and they are not interchangeable: scripts/commit_gate.py:221 reads os.environ for --hook (pre-commit), while declares_bulk(message) at :103 is used by single_commit_bulk_declaration for the push range. A commit message containing ALLOW_BULK_COMMIT=1 alone still blocks at the hook. Correct usage is 'ALLOW_BULK_COMMIT=1 git commit ...' with the declaration also written in the message so the push gate can see it.

title: A ledger's capture paths resolve against the ledger's directory, not the repo root
body: First run of tools/deere_claims_check.py reported all 8 sources missing and returned BLIND on a healthy corpus, because root was derived as the ledger path's grandparents and the ledger stores paths relative to ARC/deere/. Derive root from the ledger's own parent so the ledger can be copied with its captures; a wrong root is indistinguishable from a destroyed corpus at the verdict level.

title: A minimum quote length exposed three claims whose evidence was a date fragment
body: The 20-character floor rejected 'SO ORDERED this', 'August 1, 2026' and 'Case Status Pending'. The remedy was content, not a lowered threshold: each quote was extended to contiguous context that also carries the fact the claim needs (the blank day-of line with its 2026, the row number before the date, the Last-Updated date before the status). Lowering a threshold would have kept three claims that no reader could check in context.

title: pmb_record_batch returned ok:true with n:0 and stored nothing from a 7-item batch
body: A seven-item batch (four facts, two lessons, one activity) returned {'ok': True, 'n': 0, 'outbox_id': 1759} and stored zero rows; pmb_recall for LFM3 then returned no matching fact, which is what exposed it. Two-item and five-item batches had worked earlier in the same session, so the failure is size- or composition-dependent rather than a dead daemon. Resubmitting the same content as single-item batches returned n:1 each time. Treat n as the authority and never report a record landed on the strength of ok:true alone.

title: read_url refuses pages over 2 MB, so a large vendor blog must be reached through its docs
body: liquid.ai/blog/lfm3 returned 'Response exceeded 2000000 bytes' from the read_url extractor, while docs.liquid.ai pages on the same site read cleanly. For LFM3 the vendor docs carry the harder facts (parameter counts, layer mix, context, licence) and the blog carried the narrative (architecture search, 35% fewer parameters), so the blog figures had to be cited from dated search snippets rather than a read page. Record which channel each number came from.

The first tools/*.py match in a hook stanza body is often a remediation echo, not the executed gate: stanza 8 named supervisor_doctor in prose while running supervisor_mcp --verdict. Resolution now skips comment and echo lines and prefers the invoked script, reporting target_source=invoked|mention so the weaker claim is visible in the table.
